title: Operation steps reach only rows the caller can read
why: A step with an id or key from the input reached any row the operation's role could not read: a read step returned it, and an update, delete, action, transition or upsert step changed it and returned it.
changelog: every operation step with an id applies the resource's read policy and answers 404 for a row the caller cannot read, as for a missing one, and an `upsert` step whose key matches such a row answers 403 and rolls the operation back; B0809 warns where a role cannot read every row a write step targets
